title: Voice VLAN
description: Configure a voice VLAN so IP phones and PCs share one port without conflict.
scenario: Configure a voice VLAN so IP phones and PCs share one port without conflict.

concepts.title: What is a Voice VLAN?
concepts.body: A voice VLAN (auxiliary VLAN) carries VoIP telephone traffic. The phone tags its traffic with the voice VLAN, while the PC behind the phone stays in the data VLAN.
concepts.code:
IP Phone → Voice VLAN 50
PC via phone → Data VLAN 20

concepts.title: Configuring Voice VLAN
concepts.body: Create the voice VLAN, set the port to access mode, then assign the voice VLAN with "switchport voice vlan".
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# vlan 50
SW1(config-vlan)# name VOICE
SW1(config-if)# switchport mode access
SW1(config-if)# switchport voice vlan 50

concepts.title: Verifying Voice VLAN
concepts.body: "show interfaces status" shows only the Vlan column for ports. Use "show run interface" to see both data and voice VLANs.
concepts.code:
SW1# show running-config interface Fa0/1
switchport access vlan 20
switchport voice vlan 50

concepts.title: Data + Voice on One Port
concepts.body: When both are configured, untagged PC traffic goes to the access VLAN and tagged phone traffic goes to the voice VLAN.
